newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Oct 25.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Oct 25.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunkers held steady amid keen competition from South Korea and a holiday in Taiwan, traders said. A major said demand were above-average as a holiday in Taiwan caused shipowners to bunker in Singapore. Traders said prices in South Korea were also competitive, displacing some volumes from Singapore. MDO and gas oil prices were also steady.
